mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has fallen by at least 0.1% over the last 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% over the last month signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen by more than 0.5% over the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% and inflation accelerates (CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in 3 months), it signals a dual threat of tightening and high inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 0.3% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate over the last month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the labor market improves.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE has fallen by at least 0.1% over the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the last 3 months indicates improving consumer demand and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has risen by at least 0.5% over the last 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 900.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900.0 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) declines below 105.0, it signals a deepening economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 900.0 AND INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 235.0), a decline in the consumer price index over the last month signals cooling inflation and a shift to a more accommodative policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235.0 and CPIAUCSL has fallen by at least 0.1% over the last month.
